assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders));
assertions.purpose: 悪いクエリがNULLのため誤って0行になることを再現する

assertions.sql: SELECT group_concat(id, ',') FROM (SELECT c.id FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.id);
assertions.purpose: 改善版が未注文の顧客だけを返すことを確認する

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.id FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id));
